members.name: create_oligo
members.signature: (segments: Sequence[SegmentSpec | tuple[MutableVirtualHelix | int, int, int]], color: str='#888888', name: str | None=None, is_scaffold: bool=False, circular: bool=False)
members.doc: Create one oligo from a path of segments listed 5′ → 3′.

members.name: can_create_oligo
members.signature: (segments: Sequence[SegmentSpec | tuple[MutableVirtualHelix | int, int, int]], circular: bool=False)
members.doc: Whether :meth:`create_oligo` accepts this path: every segment in its region's bounds and on free bases, no two entries overlapping, and no junction on a skip or insertion.

members.name: can_create_segment
members.signature: (vh: MutableVirtualHelix | int, five_index: int, three_index: int)
members.doc: Whether :meth:`create_segment` accepts this segment, as ``Part.createOligo`` checks it: both ends inside the VH region's ``[min_base, max_base)`` and the range free on its strand set (``5' < 3'`` → strand set 0, else 1).

members.name: can_connect
members.doc: Whether :meth:`connect` accepts joining ``from_segment``'s 3′ end to ``to_segment``'s 5′ end: different segments, both ends free, and neither end on a skip or insertion.

members.name: can_break_oligo
members.doc: Whether :meth:`break_oligo` accepts this break: ``at_index`` inside the segment, and a mid-segment break not leaving a new end on a skip or insertion.

members.name: get_slot_at
members.signature: (vh: MutableVirtualHelix | int, strand_index: int, bp_index: int)
members.doc: The slot at one base of one strand (``None`` where no segment covers it).

members.name: add_skip_at
members.doc: The skip tool: skip ``bp_index`` on both strands of ``vh`` (``OligoSegment.addSkipOrInsertion(bp, -1)``).

members.name: add_insert_at
members.signature: (vh: MutableVirtualHelix | int, bp_index: int, count: int=1)
members.doc: The insert tool: add ``count`` inserted bases at ``bp_index`` on both strands of ``vh``, keeping their bases. Calling it again adds more (``OligoSegment.addSkipOrInsertion(bp, count)``).

members.doc: Remove a skip or insertion at ``bp_index``: both strands go back to one base each (``OligoSegment.removeSkipOrInsertion``). Does nothing on a plain base.
